+import base64
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+
+def b64e(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(data).decode()
+
+
+def b64d(data: str) -> bytes:
+    return base64.b64decode(data.encode())
+
+
+@dataclass
+class KeyRequest:
+    key_id: str
+    plaintext: bytes
+    encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class KeyResponse:
+    key_id: str
+    ciphertext: bytes
+    encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+
+
+def normalize_context(context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    if not context:
+        return {}
+    return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in context.items()}
+
*** Add File: security_client.py
+import os
+from typing import Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def aws_region() -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"
+
+
+def kms_client():
+    return boto3.client("kms", region_name=aws_region())
+
+
+def kms_key_id(default: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("AWS_KMS_KEY_ID") or os.environ.get("KMS_KEY_ID") or (default or "")
+
+
+def encryption_context() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    context = {}
+    for key in ("APP_NAME", "ENVIRONMENT", "DATA_CLASSIFICATION"):
+        value = os.environ.get(key)
+        if value:
+            context[key.lower()] = value
+    return context
+
*** Add File: encrypt_payload.py
+from security_client import encryption_context, kms_client, kms_key_id
+from security_models import KeyRequest, KeyResponse, b64e, normalize_context
+
+
+def encrypt_payload(plaintext: bytes, key_id: str = "") -> KeyResponse:
+    client = kms_client()
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    request = KeyRequest(key_id=resolved_key_id, plaintext=plaintext, encryption_context=normalize_context(encryption_context()))
+    params = {"KeyId": request.key_id, "Plaintext": request.plaintext}
+    if request.encryption_context:
+        params["EncryptionContext"] = request.encryption_context
+    response = client.encrypt(**params)
+    return KeyResponse(key_id=response["KeyId"], ciphertext=response["CiphertextBlob"], encryption_context=request.encryption_context)
+
+
+def encrypt_payload_text(text: str, key_id: str = "") -> str:
+    return b64e(encrypt_payload(text.encode(), key_id).ciphertext)
+

+
*** Add File: envelope_encrypt.py
+import os
+
+import boto3
+
+from security_client import aws_region, encryption_context, kms_key_id
+from security_models import b64d, b64e, normalize_context
+
+
+def envelope_encrypt(plaintext: bytes, key_id: str = ""):
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=aws_region())
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    data_key = kms.generate_data_key(KeyId=resolved_key_id, KeySpec="AES_256", EncryptionContext=normalize_context(encryption_context()))
+    plaintext_key = data_key["Plaintext"]
+    encrypted_key = data_key["CiphertextBlob"]
+    encrypted = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(plaintext, (plaintext_key * ((len(plaintext) // len(plaintext_key)) + 1))[: len(plaintext)]))
+    return {"encrypted_data_key": b64e(encrypted_key), "ciphertext": b64e(encrypted), "encryption_context": normalize_context(encryption_context())}
+
+
+def envelope_decrypt(payload: dict, key_id: str = "") -> bytes:
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=aws_region())
+    decrypted_key = kms.decrypt(CiphertextBlob=b64d(payload["encrypted_data_key"]), EncryptionContext=payload.get("encryption_context") or {})["Plaintext"]
+    ciphertext = b64d(payload["ciphertext"])
+    return bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(ciphertext, (decrypted_key * ((len(ciphertext) // len(decrypted_key)) + 1))[: len(ciphertext)]))
+
*** Add File: sign_or_verify_key.py
+import os
+
+from security_client import aws_region, kms_client, kms_key_id
+from security_models import b64d, b64e
+
+
+def sign_message(message: bytes, key_id: str = "") -> str:
+    client = kms_client()
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    response = client.sign(KeyId=resolved_key_id, Message=message, MessageType="RAW", SigningAlgorithm="RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256")
+    return b64e(response["Signature"])
+
+
+def verify_message(message: bytes, signature_b64: str, key_id: str = "") -> bool:
+    client = kms_client()
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    response = client.verify(KeyId=resolved_key_id, Message=message, MessageType="RAW", Signature=b64d(signature_b64), SigningAlgorithm="RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256")
+    return bool(response.get("SignatureValid"))
+
*** Add File: key_usage_summary.py
+import boto3
+
+from security_client import aws_region
+
+
+def key_usage_summary(key_id: str):
+    cloudwatch = boto3.client("cloudwatch", region_name=aws_region())
+    return cloudwatch.list_metrics(Namespace="AWS/KMS", Dimensions=[{"Name": "KeyId", "Value": key_id}])
+
*** Add File: payload_safety.py
+import boto3
+
+from security_client import aws_region
+
+
+def payload_safety(text: str) -> dict:
+    comprehend = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=aws_region())
+    sentiment = comprehend.detect_sentiment(Text=text[:5000], LanguageCode="en")
+    return {"unsafe": sentiment.get("Sentiment") in {"NEGATIVE", "MIXED"}, "sentiment": sentiment.get("Sentiment"), "scores": sentiment.get("SentimentScore", {})}
+
*** Add File: crypto_audit_embedding.py
+import boto3
+
+from security_client import aws_region
+
+
+def crypto_audit_embedding(notes: str):
+    bedrock = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=aws_region())
+    body = {"inputText": notes}
+    return bedrock.invoke_model(body=str(body).encode(), modelId="amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0", accept="application/json", contentType="application/json")
+
*** Add File: compliance_note_translate.py
+import boto3
+
+from security_client import aws_region
+
+
+def compliance_note_translate(text: str, target_language_code: str):
+    translate = boto3.client("translate", region_name=aws_region())
+    return translate.translate_text(Text=text, SourceLanguageCode="auto", TargetLanguageCode=target_language_code)
+
*** End Patch

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import base64
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+
+def b64e(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(data).decode()
+
+
+def b64d(data: str) -> bytes:
+    return base64.b64decode(data.encode())
+
+
+@dataclass
+class KeyRequest:
+    key_id: str
+    plaintext: bytes
+    encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class KeyResponse:
+    key_id: str
+    ciphertext: bytes
+    encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+
+
+def normalize_context(context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    if not context:
+        return {}
+    return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in context.items()}

@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import os
+from typing import Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def aws_region() -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("AWS_REGION") or os.environ.get("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"
+
+
+def kms_client():
+    return boto3.client("kms", region_name=aws_region())
+
+
+def kms_key_id(default: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("AWS_KMS_KEY_ID") or os.environ.get("KMS_KEY_ID") or (default or "")
+
+
+def encryption_context() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    context = {}
+    for key in ("APP_NAME", "ENVIRONMENT", "DATA_CLASSIFICATION"):
+        value = os.environ.get(key)
+        if value:
+            context[key.lower()] = value
+    return context

+from security_client import encryption_context, kms_client, kms_key_id
+from security_models import KeyRequest, KeyResponse, b64e, normalize_context
+
+
+def encrypt_payload(plaintext: bytes, key_id: str = "") -> KeyResponse:
+    client = kms_client()
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    request = KeyRequest(key_id=resolved_key_id, plaintext=plaintext, encryption_context=normalize_context(encryption_context()))
+    params = {"KeyId": request.key_id, "Plaintext": request.plaintext}
+    if request.encryption_context:
+        params["EncryptionContext"] = request.encryption_context
+    response = client.encrypt(**params)
+    return KeyResponse(key_id=response["KeyId"], ciphertext=response["CiphertextBlob"], encryption_context=request.encryption_context)
+
+
+def encrypt_payload_text(text: str, key_id: str = "") -> str:
+    return b64e(encrypt_payload(text.encode(), key_id).ciphertext)

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import os
+
+import boto3
+
+from security_client import aws_region, encryption_context, kms_key_id
+from security_models import b64d, b64e, normalize_context
+
+
+def envelope_encrypt(plaintext: bytes, key_id: str = ""):
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=aws_region())
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    data_key = kms.generate_data_key(KeyId=resolved_key_id, KeySpec="AES_256", EncryptionContext=normalize_context(encryption_context()))
+    plaintext_key = data_key["Plaintext"]
+    encrypted_key = data_key["CiphertextBlob"]
+    encrypted = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(plaintext, (plaintext_key * ((len(plaintext) // len(plaintext_key)) + 1))[: len(plaintext)]))
+    return {"encrypted_data_key": b64e(encrypted_key), "ciphertext": b64e(encrypted), "encryption_context": normalize_context(encryption_context())}
+
+
+def envelope_decrypt(payload: dict, key_id: str = "") -> bytes:
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=aws_region())
+    decrypted_key = kms.decrypt(CiphertextBlob=b64d(payload["encrypted_data_key"]), EncryptionContext=payload.get("encryption_context") or {})["Plaintext"]
+    ciphertext = b64d(payload["ciphertext"])
+    return bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(ciphertext, (decrypted_key * ((len(ciphertext) // len(decrypted_key)) + 1))[: len(ciphertext)]))

+import os
+
+from security_client import aws_region, kms_client, kms_key_id
+from security_models import b64d, b64e
+
+
+def sign_message(message: bytes, key_id: str = "") -> str:
+    client = kms_client()
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    response = client.sign(KeyId=resolved_key_id, Message=message, MessageType="RAW", SigningAlgorithm="RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256")
+    return b64e(response["Signature"])
+
+
+def verify_message(message: bytes, signature_b64: str, key_id: str = "") -> bool:
+    client = kms_client()
+    resolved_key_id = key_id or kms_key_id()
+    response = client.verify(KeyId=resolved_key_id, Message=message, MessageType="RAW", Signature=b64d(signature_b64), SigningAlgorithm="RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256")
+    return bool(response.get("SignatureValid"))
